choice.basis: The chart is titled 'Public Service Feedback Share by Category' and includes explicit percentage labels for each feedback category. The labels are: Service Quality (41%), Service Cost (46%), Service Design (51%), Support Access (42%), Service Delivery (36%), and Other (10%). The routing criterion is the 'Highest feedback share in the dashboard.' Comparing the printed percentages, Service Design has the highest share at 51%. The vertical position on the 'Value' axis does not correspond to the printed percentages (e.g., the 51% marker is plotted lower than the 41% marker), so the printed labels are the valid encoding of share. Service Design is the category that should enter the priority follow-up workflow.
choice.option_label: Route Service Design to public feedback priority follow-up
